sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Sophie Casterwill used this spell to protect the team when Dante used Ignatius's flames to burn away Klaus's mutant flying spiders. [The Bookshop Hunter] 

The Mermen of Atlantis used this spell to defend themselves from Dante Vale's Doublespell Boltflare in the Test of Prowess. [Coming of Age]

Sophie again used this spell to protect herself from the effect of Kiel's Fireswarm. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

This spell was preemptively used by Dante Vale to protect him from Kiel's Armorburn in the massive war against the Blood Spirals next to the Fortress of Iron Will. In the same war, Sophie later used Chillskin in the exact same way versus Kiel next to the fortress' door. [The Spiral War]

full_text:
Chillskin is a shielding spell that creates a barrier of blue energy as protection from fire-based dangers. It is the cold equivalent to the fiery spell Armorburn.

== History ==
Sophie Casterwill used this spell to protect the team when Dante used Ignatius's flames to burn away Klaus's mutant flying spiders. [The Bookshop Hunter] 

The Mermen of Atlantis used this spell to defend themselves from Dante Vale's Doublespell Boltflare in the Test of Prowess. [Coming of Age]

Sophie again used this spell to protect herself from the effect of Kiel's Fireswarm. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

This spell was preemptively used by Dante Vale to protect him from Kiel's Armorburn in the massive war against the Blood Spirals next to the Fortress of Iron Will. In the same war, Sophie later used Chillskin in the exact same way versus Kiel next to the fortress' door. [The Spiral War]
